agent_notes: Normal TLS to the expected official hostname www.iiti.ac.in returned curl error 60 for a self-signed certificate in the proxy chain; after confirming the hostname, public GET requests used curl --insecure only, with no credentials or private data.

The official catalogue exposes Bachelor of Technology, Bachelor of Design, Bachelor of Science, Master of Technology (including the three-year route), Master of Science, Master of Science (Research), Master of Arts, Ph.D., and the listed dual-degree families. No diploma or certificate programme was shown on the official academic or admissions catalogue pages reviewed.
Duration was populated only where the official UG/PG admissions pages explicitly stated it. Ph.D. and dual-degree durations and unlisted eligibility details remain null.

Career-tree mappings were checked with read-only SQLite queries. Approximate mappings are labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization with medium/low confidence; unsupported generic or interdisciplinary offerings retain a mapping gap.
